notes.title: Introducing Thrusters!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26604516/99ce6baa1b6640ae2fc1874e9effc468b87af5e5.gif[/img]

ːsteamhappyːThis upgrade brings in ship thrusters. Move your launch vehicle side to side by upgrading your thrusters. This gives you a new angle of attack and allows unique play options for each level.
